demoNote: DEMO MODE · Sample data. Changes are not sent to a device.
intro: Fine-tune haptics, audio and your adapter. Right in your browser, with no application to install.
step1: Plug the adapter into a USB port on your computer.
step2: Press PS to turn on the controller. For first-time pairing, hold PS + Create until the controller flashes.
step3: Click Connect adapter and select the device from the list.
secureHint: Settings stay between your browser and the adapter. No account or cloud.
unsupported: This browser does not support WebHID. Use desktop Chrome or Edge over HTTPS or localhost.
unknown: Unsupported firmware version. Configuration read and write are disabled to prevent using an incompatible layout.
summaryHint: Check your connection and make the controller feel right for you.
controllerHint: Fine-tune haptics and adaptive trigger resistance.
audioHint: Controller audio and microphone. You can also adjust volume in your operating system.
adapterHint: Device behavior and connection to your computer.
shortcutsHint: Shortcuts supported by the selected firmware.
defaultsConfirm: Prepare default settings in the form? This replaces your edits. Nothing is sent to the device until you click Save changes.
saveResult: Settings applied; save command sent. Verify persistence after disconnecting power.
demoSaved: Demo settings applied. No operation was performed on a physical device.
replug: USB settings changed. Unplug and reconnect the adapter. This does not update firmware.
reconnectConfirm: Reconnecting USB interrupts controller and audio operation. Continue? This is not a firmware reboot or a flash persistence test.
reconnectSent: USB reconnect command sent. Connect the adapter again.
defaultsReady: Defaults are ready in the form. Review them and click Save changes.
noDevice: Connect a compatible adapter to edit settings.
limits: Nine custom shortcuts and button remapping are not supported by v0.7.2-hotfix. Reports intended for newer firmware are not sent.
psHelp: Tap PS: Win + G. Hold PS for at least 750 ms: Win + Tab. Enabling the USB keyboard requires unplugging and reconnecting the adapter. The shortcut may also trigger a game overlay.
volumeHint: Your operating system or game may override these values. This release has no volume lock or synchronization setting.
legal: Independent product. Not affiliated with or authorized by Sony Interactive Entertainment. DualSense and PlayStation are trademarks of their respective owners.
licenseIntro: This panel has its own interface and protocol implementation. No code or artwork from the original configurator is included.
releaseNote: Profile based on v0.7.2-hotfix source code. Physical adapter and Windows 11 acceptance testing is required.
verifyHint: After saving, physically unplug the adapter from power. Reconnect the same adapter, connect it in the panel, then compare settings.
verifyConfirm: Have you physically disconnected adapter power since saving and reconnected the same device? Disconnect or Reconnect USB alone is not sufficient.
verified: The readback matches the saved settings after the power cycle you confirmed.
mismatch: Readback differs from the settings sent for saving. Persistence has not been confirmed.
savedDraft: A comparison point from a previous save is available.
operationFailed: Operation failed. If writing started, the result is uncertain; reconnect and read the current settings.
permission: The browser denied device access. Check site permissions and close other configurators.
conflict: Configuration changed outside this panel. Saving stopped. Reconnect to read current settings.
timeout: The device did not respond in time. Reconnect it.
invalid: Invalid data or incompatible device profile. Writing is blocked.
connectionLost: Adapter connection lost. Unsaved changes are not confirmed.

fieldHints.triggerReduction: 0 = automatic. Some game effects do not respond to reduction.
fieldHints.audioBuffer: Firmware range: 16–128. Smaller buffers may increase dropouts.
fieldHints.ledDisabled: Low-battery warnings may flash the LED despite this setting.
fieldHints.wake: Requires USB wake support in the operating system and BIOS/UEFI.
